title: cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && set -e && echo '=== docs/plans tree ===' && find docs/plans -type f 2>/dev/null |
command: cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && set -e && echo '=== docs/plans tree ===' && find docs/plans -type f 2>/dev/null | sort && echo '' && echo '=== other plan-like files outside docs/plans ===' && find docs -type f -name '*.md' -not -path 'docs/plans/*' | xargs grep -l -iE 'status:.*(draft|wip|in.progress|stale|done|complete|superseded)' 2>/dev/null | sort && echo '' && echo '=== handoff files ===' && find docs -type f -iname '*handoff*' 2>/dev/null | sort && echo '' && echo '=== top-level docs ===' && ls docs/*.md 2>/dev/null | sort
